","created":"2026-08-21T18:08:21.912-0400","updated":"2026-08-21T18:08:21.912-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"jsdPublic":true},{"id":"3302985","author":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"body":"

Root cause narrowed. The documents are not missing. attachments.aspx resolves the wrong blob path for default forms.

Evidence. PrinterFriendlyReport-Property.docx returns HTTP 500 from attachments.aspx?filename=PrinterFriendlyReport-Property.docx&System=forms/case/default, inner exception Azure.RequestFailedException status 404 ErrorCode BlobNotFound, thrown at LPSBO.AzureFilesystem.DisplayBlobInBrowser line 19 from Attachments.aspx.vb line 21. The Verify action on the same file calls BrowseForms-Verify.aspx?FormName=PrinterFriendlyReport-Property.docx&loc=2, returns 200 and lists 44 merge fields with no error. Same file, two code paths, one works.

Scope. All three Default Forms fail on open and all three verify successfully. Pre-filled forms download normally through the same screen. The failure cuts by document type, not by file or by user. Storage access itself is healthy.

Upload. incident_408 forms_case Internal PVH.docx transfers fully, handler reports fileUploadedSize 26436 of 26436 and progress 100. The filename appears in no subsequent BrowseForms-Manage.aspx response and is not listed. No error anywhere in the HAR.

Separate code defect: DisplayBlobInBrowser calls GetProperties without handling BlobNotFound, so an unresolved path becomes an unhandled exception page instead of a message to the user.

Ruled out: missing files, broken storage access, filename spaces, and a single bad document.

Still open: whether other users on this tenant see the same, and whether other migrated clients resolve default forms to the wrong path.

Unrelated, logged separately: the same screen prints "Could not Find entry in Screen Label table" for mnu_BackToMenu and mnu_UserTools.

","created":"2026-08-21T18:41:11.830-0400","updated":"2026-08-21T18:41:48.914-0400","updateAuthor":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"jsdPublic":false},{"id":"3302990","author":{"accountId":"712020:688bd119-6d13-450b-95ac-b1ef3fbb547b","displayName":"Juan Martinez"},"body":"

CLIENT: PVH Corp (platform id 408)
SOURCE: RCS-28469
ENVIRONMENT: US Production
URL: https://apps.apprissretail.com/pvh/nettrack/Admin/BrowseForms-Manage.aspx

SUMMARY
Documents under Default Forms cannot be opened. attachments.aspx returns HTTP 500 with an inner BlobNotFound for every one of them, while the same files open correctly through the Verify screen, which reads them and lists their merge fields. The blob is reachable. The path attachments.aspx builds for it is not. Documents under Pre-filled Forms download normally, so the failure cuts cleanly by document type. Separately, uploading a new document transfers in full and is never persisted or listed, with no error shown.

STEPS TO REPRODUCE
Source: customer report plus support reproduction on 21 August, HARs attached.

  1. Open Admin, Document Management on the PVH tenant.

  2. Under Default Forms, click any of the three documents. All three fail.

  3. Observe the error page, then open Technical Details.

  4. On the same row, click Verify. The document opens and its merge fields are listed.

  5. Under Pre-filled Forms, click any document. It downloads.

  6. Under Add Documents, browse to any .docx and click Upload. Watch it reach 100 percent, then check the lists.

EXPECTED
The document opens. The uploaded file is stored and appears in the list.

ACTUAL
Read, Default Forms: HTTP 500 from attachments.aspx?filename=<name>&System=forms/case/default. Inner exception Azure.RequestFailedException, status 404, ErrorCode BlobNotFound, thrown at LPSBO.AzureFilesystem.DisplayBlobInBrowser line 19, called from Attachments.aspx.vb line 21. Confirmed on all three documents.
Read, same files through Verify: BrowseForms-Verify.aspx?FormName=<name>&loc=2 returns 200 and lists the merge fields. PrinterFriendlyReport-Property.docx yields 44 fields with no error anywhere in the response.
Read, Pre-filled Forms: downloads normally.
Write: the DevExpress upload handler reports fileUploadedSize 26436 of 26436 and progress 100. The filename appears in no subsequent response, the file is not listed, and no error is raised.

ALREADY RULED OUT
Missing files. The Verify screen opens the same documents that fail and lists their merge fields, so the content is present and readable.
Broken storage access. Pre-filled forms download through the same page.
Filename characters. The Blank Forms list already contains uploaded documents with spaces in the name.
A single bad file. All three default forms fail and all three verify successfully.

INVESTIGATION LEADS

  1. Attachments.aspx composes the wrong blobName for default forms. The System parameter carries forms/case/default and Page_Load builds blobName from it before calling DisplayBlobInBrowser. Rests on the same file resolving through the Verify path and failing through this one, and on the failure cutting by document type rather than by file.

  2. Default forms live under a different prefix or container than the one attachments.aspx assumes, possibly a leftover from migration. Rests on Pre-filled loc=1 succeeding and Default loc=2 failing on the same screen.
    The test that separates them: log the exact blobName string DisplayBlobInBrowser receives for a default form, and compare it against the path the Verify code path resolves for the same file.

Note: storage is healthy. Pre-filled documents download and Verify reads the failing files, so credentials, container existence and connectivity are all working.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

  1. Default Forms open and download for this client, as Pre-filled already do.

  2. An uploaded document is persisted and appears in the list without a page refresh workaround.

  3. A missing blob returns a handled message to the user rather than an unhandled exception page.

  4. Uploaded documents are persisted and listed, or the user is told why they were not.

  5. A check exists to identify other migrated clients whose default forms resolve to the wrong path.

EVIDENCE
HAR of the upload attempt. HAR of the Verify run showing BrowseForms-Verify.aspx succeeding on the same documents. Technical Details output from two separate 500s, Internal and Property. Screenshots of Document Management and Default Forms.
